title: HIFI raises $37M to expand stablecoin payments, tokenized markets
message_html: HIFI raises $37M to expand stablecoin payments, tokenized markets ...
snippet: HIFI CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph the $37 million Series A is the company’s first priced funding round, though HIFI did not disclose its valuation.

title: Kredete acquires Gravv to build stablecoin infrastructure
message_html: Kredete acquires Gravv to build stablecoin infrastructure ...
snippet: Kredete, the financial technology platform serving emerging-market and diaspora communities, today announced its acquisition of Gravv, an agentic stablecoin infrastructure platform that connects banks, blockchain networks, and local payment rails for real-time global money movement.
